easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Mode:
Separate Easy Place mode that only places blocks with normal vanilla clicks:
look at a missing schematic block and right click. The correct item is picked
automatically and a visible, reachable neighbor face is clicked.
No air place, no fake rotations, no special packets.
Independent from Litematica's old Easy Place (keep that one off).
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Dela:
Delay between two placements while holding right click, in game ticks
(20 ticks = 1 second). 4 is the vanilla speed, higher values are slower.
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Stri:
When enabled, only the face that your crosshair actually hits
(the block behind the ghost block) is clicked, exactly like a plain vanilla right click.
When disabled, any other neighbor face that is visible and in reach may be used.
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Debu: Shows in the action bar and the log why a block was skipped.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerToggleH: Starts or stops the printer without opening the menu.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerTurnSpe: How fast the camera turns to the next block (degrees per second).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerTurnJit: Varying speed and a slightly curved path so turning looks more natural.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerExtraDe: Up to this many ticks are randomly added to the placement delay.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerInvento: Shortest pause between inventory steps (open, swap item, close).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerReachMa: The printer stays this many blocks below the normal reach.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerUseBari:
When enabled, Baritone walks to blocks out of reach.
Baritone never builds or breaks anything itself.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerUseLaye: Only builds the layers Litematica currently renders (render layers).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerHud: Small status display in the top left while the printer runs.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerFastTur:
When enabled, the head snaps to the block within one frame and places on the next tick
(only up to the max angle, larger turns stay smooth).
When disabled, the camera turns smoothly. Either way the block orientation comes from the
look direction like in vanilla; if it does not fit, the printer walks to a matching side.
easyplace2.config.prettyName.printerFast: Printer: fast turn up to angle
easyplace2.config.comment.printerFastTur: Fast turn only if the view already points roughly that way (degrees).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerReactio: Minimum ticks the crosshair stays on the target before clicking.
Maximum ticks the crosshair stays on the target before clicking.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerPauseOn: When the player takes damage, the printer pauses for 3 seconds.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerTheme: Color scheme of the printer menu (vault, nova, rose, ember, forest, indigo, magenta, ocean, crimson, lime, gold, aurora).
easyplace2.config.comment.printerGlass: Translucent menu with the blurred world behind it.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerGridVie: Show options in the menu as tiles instead of a list.

easyplace2.printer.info.how1: The printer finds the missing blocks of all active Litematica placements and builds from the bottom up.
easyplace2.printer.info.how2: If a block is out of reach, Baritone walks to a spot from which vanilla places the block the right way around. Baritone never builds or breaks anything itself.
easyplace2.printer.info.how3: If the item is not in the hotbar, the inventory is opened like a player would, the item is moved to the hotbar with a number key and the inventory is closed again.
easyplace2.printer.info.how4: Then the camera turns to the neighbor face and a normal right click follows through Easy Place 2.0 with strict crosshair.
easyplace2.printer.info.server: Only use it where it is allowed. If an anti-cheat runs, the server admin can exempt you (with Grim e.g. via the permission grim.exempt).
easyplace2.printer.msg.started: Started. The printer waits while a menu is open.
easyplace2.printer.msg.no_schematic: No active schematic found. Load a placement in Litematica.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerShulker: When material runs out, the printer places a shulker from the inventory next to itself, takes the material and breaks it again.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerStorage: When material runs out and no fitting shulker is carried, the printer fetches it from marked storage containers.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerMarkSto: Marks the container under the crosshair as storage (or removes the mark).
easyplace2.printer.head.materials.sub: What is still needed and where it is
easyplace2.printer.head.storage.sub: Chests, barrels and shulkers the printer takes materials from
easyplace2.printer.opt.shulkerRefill.des: Place a shulker from the inventory, take materials, break it again
easyplace2.printer.opt.storageRefill.des: Walk to marked containers and fetch materials
easyplace2.printer.material.none: No schematic scanned yet. Start the printer or load a placement.
easyplace2.printer.storage.empty: No storage containers marked yet. Look at a chest, barrel or shulker, open this menu and click "+ Container under crosshair" – or bind the key "Mark storage" under Keybinds.
easyplace2.printer.storage.unknown: Contents unknown – open it once and the printer remembers them
easyplace2.printer.key.storage.desc: Mark or unmark the container under the crosshair as storage

easyplace2.config.comment.moduleInvseeAn: How many degrees the player may be away from your look direction.
easyplace2.config.comment.moduleInvseeRa: At most this many blocks away.
easyplace2.config.comment.moduleInvseeCo: Command without /, {name} is replaced with the player name.
easyplace2.printer.opt.invseeAngle.desc: How far the player may be away from your look direction
easyplace2.printer.opt.invseeRange.desc: At most this far away (bind the key under Keybinds)
easyplace2.printer.key.invsee.desc: Sends /invsee for the nearest player within the view angle
easyplace2.module.invsee.none: No player within the view angle.
easyplace2.printer.msg.done: Done! %s of %s blocks match (%s wrong blocks were left alone).
easyplace2.printer.msg.stuck: Stuck: no progress for %s s (%s blocks open, %s skipped). Paused – have a look and press Resume.
easyplace2.printer.msg.scaffold_left: %s scaffold blocks could not be removed (list in config/easyplace2_scaffold.json).
easyplace2.printer.opt.scaffold.desc: Baritone may place filler blocks to get up; everything is removed afterwards
easyplace2.printer.opt.stuckSeconds.desc: This long without progress, then the printer looks for a way out
easyplace2.config.comment.printerScaffol: Baritone may place filler blocks (scaffold) while walking to get up or across gaps. The printer remembers each one and removes it again.
Which blocks may be used as scaffold, comma separated. Anything the schematic itself needs is never used as scaffold.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerStuckSe: If nothing progresses for this many seconds, the printer tries in turn: retry everything, walk out, remove nearby scaffold. If nothing helps it pauses and tells you.
easyplace2.config.comment.easyPlace2Rest:
If on: while Easy Place 2.0 is on, blocks can only be placed at the right spot of the schematic.
Clicks that would place a block anywhere else are blocked.
Using chests, doors etc. and items like food or buckets still works normally.
easyplace2.printer.opt.restrict.desc: Place blocks only at the right spot, nowhere else
easyplace2.message.restricted: Easy Place 2.0: no missing schematic block here
easyplace2.printer.opt.excavate.desc: Break blocks where the schematic wants air
easyplace2.printer.opt.replaceWrong.desc: Break wrong blocks and place the right ones
easyplace2.config.comment.printerExcavat: Breaks blocks inside the schematic area where the schematic wants air (e.g. when building into a hill). Top to bottom, never below your own feet. Chests and other blocks with contents and blocks next to water or lava are left alone.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerReplace: If a different block stands at a schematic position, it is broken and the right one is placed. Chests and other blocks with contents are left alone.
easyplace2.printer.opt.runInMenus.desc: Keep building with ESC, chat or this menu open (not chests)
easyplace2.config.comment.printerRunInMe: If on: when you press ESC, type in chat or have the printer menu open, the printer keeps building (on servers; in singleplayer ESC pauses the whole game). It waits while inventories and chests are open. Behind a menu it only uses blocks that are already in the hotbar.
easyplace2.printer.opt.laneMode.desc: Straight to the end, turn, back right next to it
easyplace2.printer.opt.laneSpacing.desc: 1 = right next to it (always 3 with star tool)
easyplace2.printer.opt.starTool.desc: Dig 3x3 tunnels with the star pickaxe
easyplace2.config.comment.printerLaneMod: Excavate and build in lanes: straight to the end of the schematic, turn, and back right next to it. Excavating digs a tunnel 1 wide and 2 high; when a layer is done it goes 2 blocks down.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerLaneSpa: Distance between lanes in blocks. 1 = right next to it. Always 3 with the star tool.
easyplace2.config.comment.printerStarToo: For a server pickaxe that breaks 3x3: tunnels 3 wide and 3 high, the player stands in the middle and hits the middle block, 3 blocks down. If the 3x3 area would hit something that should stay, it digs block by block with another tool.
How the star pickaxe is recognised in the hotbar: part of its name (case does not matter). It is never used otherwise, so nothing is broken 3x3 by accident.
easyplace2.printer.opt.fastBuild.desc: As fast as holding right click, without extra pauses
easyplace2.config.comment.printerFastBui: If on: clicks spaced by 'Delay (ticks)' like holding right click, without reaction time or extra pause. Whether the server keeps the block is checked on the side while the next one is already being aimed at. Shorter pauses in the inventory.
